invariants.rationale: A valid insert operation likely requires a defined instantTime.
Each insert is directed at a specific file; fileId is likely required and non-empty.
partitionPath is used to locate where data will be inserted, so it's expected to be non-null.
An insert only makes sense if there are records to insert, so recordMap is likely expected to be non-null and non-empty.
The map of records should not contain null values in its collection.
